title: FastHook Control API — Partial contract
description: A deliberately partial contract for stable FastHook Control API surfaces. It does not claim coverage of the complete Control API.
$comment: Coverage: partial; surfaces: project-api-keys, filter-crud, filter-test, transformation-crud, transformation-execution-history, transformation-test, transformation-capabilities, workflow-crud, workflow-run-history, workflow-step-retry, action-crud, connection-crud, connection-latest-input, source-crud, destination-crud, provider-accounts, provider-catalogs, action-options, resource-metrics, request-reads, event-attempt-reads, request-event-mutations.

api_key.description: Returned only by createProjectApiKey. Store it immediately; it cannot be retrieved later.

MetricsTimeExpression.description: ISO 8601 timestamp or relative expression such as now-24h.

RequestCursor.description: Opaque descending-page cursor returned as next_cursor.

MetricsMeasures.description: One or more comma-separated metric names. The measures query parameter may also be repeated.

MetricsResourceIds.description: One or more comma-separated resource identifiers. The id query parameter may also be repeated.

EventBatchOperationScope.description: Bulk-operation membership view. Compatibility aliases are normalized by the server.
